title: Document user database and storage locations
description: Clarify where Loreweaver keeps static data and live user data in the local CLI MVP and what should change for distribution. Cover bundled/static module and SRD data, live campaign SQLite databases, Dolt checkpoint repos, beads separation, config/env files, and the rule that provider secrets must not enter campaign DBs or checkpoints. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: User-facing docs explain default and configurable storage locations, including LOREWEAVER_DB_PATH, <dbPath>.checkpoints, bundled static content in the package, and secret exclusions; any missing default path or app-data-directory decision is filed or resolved.
close_reason: Documented local storage model in README and docs/storage.md; filed loreweaver-ygm for the unresolved default app-data decision; verification: npm run typecheck and npm run test passed.

comments.author: Joseph Bongaarts
